title: Three ways to get your project moving again.
lead: Clear offers, each with a deliverable at the end. No price list online: we scope the need together, then I send you a proposal.

items.title: Technical audit
items.forWho: You feel things are dragging without knowing why, or you are preparing a rebuild, a fundraising or an acquisition and need an independent view.
deliverables: A clear report: architecture, code quality, tests, CI/CD, security, debt
A map of the risks, prioritised
A one-hour debrief with the team

items.title: Tech Lead / Lead Dev engagement
items.duration: 3 to 12 months · full or part time
items.forWho: Your team lacks a technical lead, or needs more rigour without slowing its delivery.
deliverables: A technical framework: architecture, conventions, code reviews
CI/CD and tests that secure every release
Code delivered, and a team that grows
Documented decisions (ADRs) and a clean handover

items.title: Project rescue
items.forWho: Your project is late, unstable, or taken over from a contractor, and every release to production is a worry.
deliverables: A realistic recovery plan, agreed with you
A documented handover to your team

items.title: We talk
items.text: 30 minutes to understand your situation and your constraints.

items.title: I scope the need
items.text: A written proposal: scope, deliverables, duration.

items.title: We start
items.text: Remote by default, travel possible in Île-de-France.

quiz.title: Not sure what you need?
quiz.text: Take the “Is your project stuck?” test: 2 minutes, a score, concrete next steps.
